memory_update.text: NNI is the cleanest public reference anchor for the student-loan servicing and education payments stack because it combines LSS and ETSP segment exposure.
FLYW is a direct higher-education payments and student financial software candidate; verify education vertical revenue concentration before promoting beyond Layer 1.
PAY is an underfollowed education-payments infrastructure candidate, but education appears to be a vertical within a broader bill-payment platform; segment mix requires verification.
BLKB is a speculative-underfollowed K-12/private-school tuition-management candidate; relevance is strongest for education payments, weaker for student-loan servicing.
Need a later pass to map private but important campus payment providers such as Transact Campus and compare their public-market substitutes or acquirers.

node: Student-loan servicing, education payments, communications, and compliance systems
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a concentrated set of US-listed companies directly tied to regulated education payment and servicing workflows. Nelnet is the cleanest reference anchor because it combines student-loan servicing systems with education technology and payments. Flywire is a higher-education payments and student financial software platform. Paymentus and Blackbaud are underfollowed discovery-lane candidates because their education payment exposure is embedded inside broader billing, payments, nonprofit, or K-12 software categories rather than simple edtech screens.
